summary: Dashy is an open-source personal dashboard designed to act as a central hub for your homelab. It allows you to organise and launch links to your various self-hosted services through a structured layout configured via a local file.
goodFor: It suits self-hosters who want a customisable, text-configured landing page to keep track of numerous internal services in one browser tab.
watchOut: Managing the configuration entirely through text files can become tedious if you frequently add or modify services, requiring manual edits rather than a web interface.
deployNotes: As a containerised Node.js application, it typically requires a persistent volume mounted for your configuration file and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination if accessed externally.
